H20's in-hand + vel-jump + apex filters suggest these are not held-ball artifacts. H24's methodology applied here to characterize the adjacent pool's precision.

conclusion: The H20-KEPT 'adjacent' pool is even lower precision than the H20-KEPT 'e6c_not_in_h7v2' pool (P_real 17% vs 22-62%). 4/12 candidates are clearly FALSE, dominated by (a) cross-hand artifacts where source is at one hand and target at the other, and (b) continuous upward paths that look like V-shapes but are actually a single ball passing through the hand region without reversing. V_SHALLOW candidates in the adjacent pool are 0/2 = 0% REAL, opposite to H24's finding that V_SHALLOW is more reliable than V_DEEP. The H28 finding is consistent with H20+H24's main insight: H17's V-shape strict pool has many false positives that the in-hand + vel-jump + apex filters cannot fully reject. The 88 H20-KEPT adjacent candidates should NOT be auto-incorporated into the chain set. H28 confirms the H17->H20->H24 finding chain: the V-shape strict pool is a candidate-mining tool, not a chain-set replacement.
negative_findings: H28's 17% REAL precision is the lowest of any H20-KEPT subset QA'd so far. H17/H20's V-shape + in-hand + vel-jump + apex filter combination admits too many false positives in the 'adjacent' pool (where neither source nor target is in E6c or h7v2).
V_SHALLOW precision is 0/2 = 0% on the H28 sample. This is opposite to H24's V_SHALLOW=1/1=100% finding. The H24 V_SHALLOW sample was too small (n=1) to characterize reliability.

The dominant failure pattern (4/12 = 33%) is not 'held ball' (which H20's in-hand filter is designed for) but rather 'continuous upward path through hand region' (3/4 FALSE) and 'cross-hand pairing' (1/4 FALSE). The H20 filters do not address these failure modes.

The 'throw' half of the V-shape is more frequently visible than the 'catch' half. 6/12 candidates have a real throw visible, but only 2/12 have a real catch+throw pair. This suggests the source-end of the V-shape is the noisier part: the source's last frames often show a ball already on the hand (no descent), while the target's first frames often show a ball moving away (clear throw). The H17 V-shape logic is biased toward throwing evidence.

vision_analyze is unreliable on ball color (marker blue/orange confused with actual ball color) - this is a known issue from previous H20/H24 work. The color signal should be ignored or replaced with actual HSV histograms in future work.
recommendation: The 88 H20-KEPT adjacent candidates should NOT be auto-incorporated into the chain set. H28 confirms that the H17->H20 V-shape + filter pipeline has substantial false-positive rates in this pool (REAL precision 17%, REAL+PARTIAL precision 50%). The 2 H28 REAL candidates (13->15 identical, 10->11 youtube) and 4 H28 PARTIAL candidates may be useful for human review, but they are not high-confidence chain-set augmentations. The recommended operating point remains h7v3plus2 (H26) for hand-aware chain construction.
